semiconductor_relevance: High — ACE Solution specializes in advanced testing solutions for semiconductor devices, particularly in the areas of failure analysis and material characterization.
summary: ACE Solution Co., Ltd. provides high-end testing solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on non-destructive failure analysis, material analysis, and final test solutions. Their expertise spans across Silicon Photonics, high-speed digital, and wireless communications, enabling clients to optimize their testing processes and accelerate time-to-market.
capabilities: Non-destructive Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy for defect inspection
High-precision test platforms for GaN & SiC power modules
Modular PXIe optical test solutions for Silicon Photonics
Advanced opto-thermal metrology for thermal conductivity analysis

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, with a focus on delivering tailored test solutions.
regional_presence.China: Has branch offices in Suzhou and Shenzhen, China, to support regional operations and customer needs.
